title: Edition Review
description: Keep editorial approval tied to the submitted revision even when an author edits during review.

title: Embargo Clock
description: Release an embargoed story only after its scheduled timestamp and support postponement.

title: Locale Bundle
description: Collect a declared number of translated segments and hold publication while segments remain.

title: Alias Cutover
description: Keep a canonical URL active until the replacement target passes a probe for the same revision.

title: Comment Appeals
description: Preserve a moderation case ID across hiding, appeal, review and restoration.

title: Edit Lease
description: Control an exclusive editing window with renewal, expiry and explicit release using logical timestamps.

title: Newsletter Proof
description: Invalidate a newsletter proof after a revision and bind the send request to the approved proof.

title: Media Rights
description: Track the expiry of a licensed asset and direct the host to withdraw an expired public copy.

title: Chapter Lock
description: Prevent a book export from racing a new chapter edit by sealing a numbered manuscript snapshot.

title: Caption Review
description: Track outstanding subtitle corrections and return a corrected track for listening approval.

title: Cart Reserve
description: Reserve a fixed cart quantity, release unneeded units and commit the exact remainder.

title: Split Tender
description: Collect installments in minor units and prevent capture above the outstanding order balance.

title: Return Triage
description: Route inspected returns to stock, repair, or disposal while preserving the return authorization ID.

title: Parcel Claim
description: Hold a lost-parcel claim during carrier investigation and cancel compensation when delivery wins the race.

title: Auction Close
description: Drive a single-item ascending auction with a reserve, strictly increasing bids and a settlement handoff.

title: Gift Balance
description: Redeem a prepaid balance multiple times, decline overdrafts, and close an exhausted card.

title: Backorder Fill
description: Release a backordered line only after cumulative inbound receipts satisfy its shortage.

title: Coupon Pool
description: Manage a finite campaign redemption pool with replenishment and explicit suspension.

title: Subscription Grace
description: Control renewal, grace-period expiration and reactivation by comparing absolute billing deadlines.

title: Exchange Stock
description: Keep a replacement item reserved until receipt of the matching returned item.

title: Outbox Delivery
description: Coordinate durable outbox insertion, delivery and acknowledgement with a stable message ID.

title: Savepoint Batch
description: Control a nested transaction using a savepoint depth and reject outer commit before nested scopes close.

title: Schema Shadow
description: Protect a shadow-table cutover until the declared row backfill and an explicit consistency check finish.

title: Stream Watermark
description: Advance an event-time watermark monotonically and route late arrivals for correction.

title: Deadletter Replay
description: Replay a dead-letter batch with an explicit per-message attempt budget and manual escalation.

title: Snapshot Fence
description: Buffer changes during snapshot export and release the change feed only at a matching snapshot fence.

title: Replica Promote
description: Fence a replica promotion against its required log offset before announcing a new primary.

title: Compaction Swap
description: Retain old table segments until the replacement file has the expected record count and readers drain.

title: Microbatch Seal
description: Close a microbatch on its target row count or an early flush and release only after sink confirmation.

title: Segment Roll
description: Roll bounded log segments without losing the append that triggered rotation.

title: Canary Traffic
description: Gate ordered traffic increases on the health of the current rollout percentage.

title: Breaker Probe
description: Open a circuit after a configured number of consecutive failures and admit a single recovery probe.

title: Drain Workers
description: Stop new admissions before draining the known count of active workers and terminating a deployment.

title: Backup Chain
description: Require a base snapshot and contiguous increments before sealing a restorable backup chain.

title: Maintenance Slot
description: Track the maintenance window deadline, prevent late starts and flag overrun on completion.

title: Incident Silence
description: Suppress repeated notifications until a quiet period expires while allowing severity escalation.

title: Artifact Promote
description: Promote exactly the artifact digest token that passed staging and block substituted build IDs.

title: Mirror Repair
description: Schedule missing mirror blocks and disclose availability only after a consistency probe.

title: Reboot Ring
description: Admit nodes to a rolling reboot one at a time and wait for each health check before the next node.

title: Restore Drill
description: Verify restored row counts and run a read probe before declaring a recovery drill successful.

title: Take Punch
description: Punch a recording in and out on a monotonic sample clock and retain the captured duration.

title: Silence Gate
description: Use separate open and close amplitude thresholds to prevent chatter in an audio gate.

title: Video Keycut
description: Snap a requested cut forward to the next eligible keyframe and preserve the resulting sample boundary.

title: Proxy Encode
description: Bind a low-resolution editing proxy to an original asset ID and support regeneration after rejection.

title: Sprite Sheet
description: Assign frames into a fixed-capacity sprite atlas and reject an incomplete finalization.

title: Subtitle Clock
description: Accept nonoverlapping cues in timestamp order and mark the last closed cue for export.

title: Loudness Pass
description: Require a measured peak from a first pass before applying a bounded mastering target.

title: Frame Reorder
description: Deliver frames on the expected sequence number and signal missing ranges to the decoder.

title: Panorama Stitch
description: Track overlapping frame pairs and require a solved alignment before blending.

title: Audio Preroll
description: Prime a playback buffer and recover from underrun without emitting premature play commands.

title: Crs Handoff
description: Require the expected coordinate-system identifier before allowing a vector-layer merge.

title: Tile Pyramid
description: Publish pyramid levels in descending zoom order and close only after zoom zero is complete.

title: Sensor Warmup
description: Hold measurements during a sensor warm-up countdown and restart calibration after a reset.

title: Survey Transect
description: Visit field waypoints in order and distinguish revisits from the next required station.

title: Gauge Hysteresis
description: Raise and clear a flood-gauge advisory with a lower reset band using integer level units.

title: Survey Closure
description: Hold a survey traverse for remeasurement if its reported closure error exceeds the selected tolerance.

title: Dark Frame Stack
description: Acquire a required stack of dark frames and repeat the acquisition when a light leak is detected.

title: Sample Custody
description: Track custody of a field sample across dispatch and receipt with a matching seal number.

title: Instrument Zero
description: Apply a zero-offset correction only after repeated reference measurements agree within one count.

title: Grid Resample
description: Track remaining destination rows during raster reprojection and require an explicit nodata audit before release.

title: Fold Holdout
description: Fence training and scoring by fold ID so a late training completion cannot score the wrong holdout.

title: Label Consensus
description: Require a second independent host-provided label to agree or route the sample for adjudication.

title: Early Plateau
description: Track consecutive unimproved evaluations against a caller-selected patience budget.

title: Feature Freeze
description: Bind a model fit to one feature schema and request re-encoding when a serving schema differs.

title: Gradient Barrier
description: Coordinate a fixed count of host-deduplicated gradient contributions before a single optimizer step.

title: Checkpoint Elect
description: Keep the best model checkpoint under integer loss minimization and restore it on a stop request.

title: Annotation Budget
description: Reserve a bounded labeling budget, route affordable tasks and close the campaign when funds run out.

title: Inference Batch
description: Seal variable-size inference requests by a token budget and carry the first oversized arrival to the next batch.

title: Distill Cache
description: Seal teacher predictions at a pinned teacher revision and invalidate stale targets when it changes.

title: Embedding Reindex
description: Build and verify a new embedding index without routing queries to partially ingested vectors.

title: Pdf Signature Set
description: Collect signature fields for a PDF packet and prevent flattening while fields remain empty.

title: Print Imposition
description: Complete paired front and back impressions before counting a duplex sheet as finished.

title: Ocr Review
description: Route pages below a caller-provided confidence cutoff to human correction before indexing.

title: Outline Depth
description: Enforce one-level heading descent while allowing returns to outer levels when constructing an outline.

title: Accessible Images
description: Track unresolved image alternatives and count explicitly decorative images as reviewed.

title: Translation Memory
description: Associate one segment revision with a translation candidate and reject stale approval after source edits.

title: Mail Merge Batch
description: Track unsent records through merge, exclusion and validated spooling of an output batch.

title: Sheet Recalc
description: Fence cached spreadsheet results to the revision that triggered recalculation.

title: Archive Verify
description: Compare uncompressed member counts and request integrity checks before accepting a document archive.

title: Footnote Bind
description: Resolve forward footnote references and block typesetting while the outstanding count is positive.

title: Dock Appointments
description: Keep a loading bay available until its booked arrival time and account for late arrivals.

title: Pallet Break
description: Pick whole cases from a pallet and direct residual loose units to repacking.

title: Meter Rollover
description: Detect dial rollover and report monotonically increasing meter readings or rollover corrections.

title: Charge Session
description: Schedule a battery charging session to a target percentage with pause, resume and completion.

title: Inspection Lot
description: Release, reject or rework a lot based on observed defects and its configured acceptance limit.

title: Kit Assembly
description: Prevent packaging an incomplete kit and permit discovery of additional required components.

title: Dispatch Manifest
description: Seal one route manifest only after all listed stops have been scanned or explicitly removed.

title: Rental Turnaround
description: Bind returned equipment to its rental ID and require cleaning or repair before reissue.

title: Tank Replenish
description: Request a refill below a low-water mark and close the order only after level recovery.

title: Cycle Count
description: Freeze a bin for a blind stock count and require reconciliation for discrepancies.

title: Drag Capture
description: Keep pointer capture with its originating pointer during drag, cancel and drop.

title: Undo Cursor
description: Bound undo traversal by the number of applied edits and clear history at a committed savepoint.

title: Scene Stream
description: Load a destination game scene before detaching the current scene and discard stale load callbacks.

title: Focus Trap
description: Cycle keyboard focus around a modal boundary and release focus on dismissal.
group: Interactive software, games and device clients

title: Game Rounds
description: Advance a fixed-length round counter through scoring, disputes and finalization.
group: Interactive software, games and device clients

title: Device Pairing
description: Match a nonsecret device discovery ID across discovery, user selection and connection callbacks.

title: Offline Drafts
description: Accumulate offline edits and keep dirty status until the uploaded revision is acknowledged.

title: Gesture Hold
description: Recognize a long press on a logical clock and suppress it after sufficient movement or early release.
group: Interactive software, games and device clients

title: Animation Scrub
description: Fence asynchronous preview callbacks to the most recently selected animation frame.

title: Level Checkpoint
description: Track forward game progress while allowing respawns only at a previously committed checkpoint.

title: Lower Bound Pos
description: Locate the first element greater than or equal to a key in an ascending numeric vector. Returns the length when insertion belongs at the end.

title: Run Mode
description: Return the most frequent value in a sorted nonempty vector, choosing the smallest value on ties. Empty input returns zero.

title: Common Prefix Len
description: Find the length of the shared leading sequence of two numeric ID streams before producing a diff.

title: Ordered Subsequence
description: Test whether a series of required events appears in order, allowing unrelated events in between.

title: Sorted Overlap Count
description: Count the multiset intersection of two sorted vectors while honoring repeated keys on both sides.

title: First Inversion
description: Return the zero-based index of the first row that breaks ascending order, or minus one when sorted.

title: Stable Rank
description: Return the zero-based ascending rank of one row, breaking ties by its original index. Invalid indices return minus one.

title: Majority Index
description: Find an index containing a strict majority using cancellation and a verification pass. Return minus one if none exists.

title: Max Slice Sum
description: Find the largest contiguous sum in a numeric signal, allowing the empty slice with sum zero.

title: Balance Index
description: Find the first index where the sum of earlier values equals the sum of later values. Return minus one if none exists.

title: Zero Cross Count
description: Count sign changes in sampled audio, ignoring zero-valued plateaus.

title: Signal Energy
description: Sum squared amplitudes of a finite signal block for comparing energy across equal-length windows.

title: Peak Sample Index
description: Locate the first sample of greatest absolute magnitude, preserving the index for waveform annotation. Empty input returns minus one.

title: Lag Product
description: Compute the unnormalized autocorrelation sum at a nonnegative integer lag. A missing overlap contributes zero.

title: Fir Point
description: Evaluate one causal FIR output using taps in lag order and zero padding at the start of a signal.

title: Median Three
description: Remove isolated impulses from a three-sample window by selecting its median, including ties.

title: Pcm Sign Extend
description: Interpret an unsigned 16-bit PCM word as a signed sample. Values outside the word range return minus 32769.

title: Pixel Luma
description: Compute integer BT.601-style luma using fixed weights 77, 150 and 29 with nearest rounding. RGB channels must be bytes.

title: Alpha Over Gray
description: Composite one straight-alpha grayscale sample over an opaque background with nearest byte rounding.

title: Row Stride Align
description: Calculate padded scanline storage in bytes for a packed pixel format at a byte alignment.

title: Turn Orientation
description: Determine the direction of a planar turn from six coordinates. Returns one for counterclockwise, zero for collinear, minus one for clockwise.

title: Polygon Double Area
description: Compute the absolute doubled area of a simple planar polygon from its vertex coordinates using the shoelace sum.

title: Segment Distance Sq
description: Return squared Euclidean distance from a point to a closed segment, including the zero-length case.

title: Polyline Taxicab
description: Measure total Manhattan travel along a rectilinear path. Mismatched coordinate arrays return minus one.

title: Grid Cell Index
description: Map an in-bounds integer cell into a zero-based row-major array with explicit dimension checks.

title: Tile Parent Id
description: Map a row-major square tile ID into its parent in an even-width tile level. Reject invalid IDs and odd widths.

title: Longitude Delta
description: Find the shortest signed longitude change in degrees in the half-open interval from minus 180 to 180.

title: Point In Ring
description: Apply an even-odd ray crossing test to an open or closed polygon ring. Supply a query off the boundary.

title: Nearest Site
description: Find the first closest planar site by squared Euclidean distance. Return minus one for empty or mismatched coordinate arrays.

title: Periodic Index
description: Wrap a signed pixel or lattice coordinate into a repeating axis of positive integer width.

title: Absolute Error Mean
description: Summarize average absolute deviation between paired targets and predictions. Empty or unequal batches return minus one.

title: Symmetric Ape
description: Compute mean symmetric absolute percentage error on a 0 to 200 scale with zero contribution when both values are zero.

title: Heldout Group
description: Identify the nth distinct group in first-seen order for leave-one-group-out validation. Return its first row index or minus one.

title: Balanced Fold Start
description: Locate the start row of a balanced contiguous validation fold, giving extra rows to earlier folds. Fold count itself returns the end sentinel.

title: Pair Concordance
description: Count concordant minus discordant unordered pairs for two ranked measurements. Ties contribute zero.

title: Isotonic Breaks
description: Count adjacent violations of a nondecreasing response curve before monotonic calibration.

title: Gini Impurity
description: Compute class impurity from nonnegative class counts. An empty or zero-mass histogram yields zero.

title: Positive Rank Auc
description: Compute binary ROC AUC by positive-negative score comparisons with half credit for ties. Undefined classes return minus one.

title: Weighted Median Pos
description: Select the first sorted value index whose cumulative nonnegative weight reaches half the total. Zero total returns minus one.

title: Residual Bias
description: Measure signed mean prediction minus target for paired samples. An empty batch or mismatched lengths produces zero.

title: Cart Discount
description: Calculate a minor-unit discount capped by both an offer maximum and the subtotal. Rates are whole basis points rounded down.

title: Cash Rounding
description: Round a nonnegative amount to the nearest cash increment, resolving exact halves upwards.

title: Installment Piece
description: Distribute minor units across equal installments, assigning one extra unit to each earliest installment until the remainder is exhausted.

title: Break Even Units
description: Calculate the first whole unit count whose positive contribution margin covers fixed overhead. Return minus one for a nonpositive margin.

title: Tier Units
description: Count units charged inside one progressive pricing tier with excluded lower and included upper cumulative boundaries.

title: Unit Pack Waste
description: Compute spare slots in the final shipping case when a nonnegative order is packed into equal-size cases.

title: Inventory Days
description: Find the first demand period that cannot be filled from current stock. Return the number of fully served periods.

title: Meter Consumption
description: Compute consumption between two readings on a wrapping meter, assuming at most one wrap. Modulus is one beyond the largest reading.

title: Shelf Life Pick
description: Choose the earliest nonexpired lot with sufficient stock for an unsplit order. Ties preserve input order.

title: Bin First Fit
description: Find the first container with remaining capacity for a nonnegative item. Return minus one if no container fits.

title: Luhn Digits
description: Validate a sequence of decimal digits against the Luhn check digit, including its final digit.

title: Isbn10 Check
description: Validate ten ISBN-10 values in print order. Encode the final X as 10.

title: Ean13 Digit
description: Derive the EAN-13 check digit from exactly twelve decimal data digits. Invalid input returns minus one.

title: Fletcher16 Bytes
description: Compute Fletcher-16 on byte values modulo 255. Invalid byte input returns minus one.

title: Uleb Width
description: Determine the encoded byte length of a nonnegative integer in unsigned LEB128.

title: Zigzag Encode
description: Map signed integers to their unsigned ZigZag representation for compact varints. Inputs must fit in signed 32 bits.

title: Base64 Size
description: Calculate the number of padded Base64 characters required for a known payload byte count.

title: Utf8 Width
description: Return the byte width of a Unicode scalar encoded as UTF-8. Reject surrogate code points and values beyond Unicode.

title: Byte Order U32
description: Decode four validated bytes beginning at an offset into an unsigned big-endian 32-bit value represented exactly in FP64.

title: Packbits Extent
description: Measure decoded length of a PackBits byte stream, checking run and literal boundaries. Header 128 is a no-op.

title: Ring Occupancy
description: Count occupied slots in a one-empty-slot circular queue with wrapped read and write cursors.

title: Serial Newer
description: Compare unsigned 32-bit serial numbers under half-range ordering. Equal and exactly half-range pairs return false.

title: Buddy Order
description: Find the least buddy allocator order that holds a request in positive equal base blocks. Order zero uses one block.

title: Cache Reuse Distance
description: Count distinct addresses since the previous identical reference to estimate LRU stack distance. A cold reference returns minus one.

title: Rendezvous Winner
description: Choose an available replica from precomputed rendezvous hash scores, resolving ties by lowest index. Positive flags indicate available replicas.

title: Quorum Overlap
description: Calculate the minimum overlap between two successful quorum sets in a universe of distinct nodes.

title: Burst Backlog
description: Compute the peak queued work across synchronized arrivals followed by service at each time step. Return minus one for invalid counts.

title: Missing Sequence
description: Find the first missing ID starting at an expected ID in an ascending stream that may contain duplicates.

title: Striped Owner
description: Map a logical block address to a disk in a round-robin stripe layout with configurable blocks per stripe.

title: Deadline Miss Count
description: Count jobs missing absolute deadlines on one nonpreemptive worker in the supplied dispatch order.

title: Weekday Mask Count
description: Count allowed weekdays in a half-open span using a seven-value flag vector and the supplied starting weekday from zero to six.

title: Month Span Days
description: Return the Gregorian length of a named month for positive civil years. Invalid months and years return minus one.

title: Quarter Index
description: Map a calendar month to a one-based fiscal quarter for a configurable starting month.

title: Next Cadence
description: Find the first cadence tick at or after a time, anchored to an initial tick. Period must be positive.

title: Slot Conflict Count
description: Count half-open reservations overlapping a proposed half-open time slot. Ignore empty reservations.

title: First Free Gap
description: Find the first start time that fits a duration past sorted, possibly overlapping reservations. Ignore empty reservations.

title: Clock Unwrap
description: Convert a wrapped time-of-day to the earliest absolute minute at or after a reference minute, using a fixed 1440-minute day.

title: Session Count
description: Count activity sessions in a sorted event timeline. A gap strictly greater than the timeout starts a new session.

title: Coverage Minutes
description: Sum occupied minutes over sorted nonoverlapping activity intervals clipped to a reporting window.

title: Periodic Overlap
description: Measure minutes in a recurring daily window, including windows that cross midnight, within one specified minute-of-day interval. Equal daily endpoints mean an empty window.

title: Euclid Gcd
description: Find the greatest common divisor of two nonnegative integral measurements using Euclid's remainder algorithm.

title: Integer Sqrt
description: Return the exact floor of the square root of a nonnegative integer using division-safe binary search.

title: Horner Eval
description: Evaluate polynomial coefficients supplied from highest to lowest degree. An empty polynomial evaluates to zero.

title: Piecewise Interp
description: Linearly interpolate between sorted strictly increasing knots, extending constant values past both ends. Supply matching nonempty arrays.

title: Central Slope
description: Estimate a centered finite-difference slope at an interior sample of uniformly spaced data. Invalid positions or spacing return zero.

title: Simpson Uniform
description: Integrate an odd number of at least three equally spaced samples with composite Simpson weights. Invalid grids return zero.

title: Dot Kahan
description: Accumulate a dot product with compensated summation for bounded finite inputs. Mismatched arrays return zero.

title: Matrix Diag Sum
description: Sum the principal diagonal of a rectangular row-major matrix after validating its flattened length.

title: Newton Step
description: Apply one scalar Newton update to a root estimate with a caller-supplied derivative. Preserve the estimate for a zero derivative.

title: Mean Abs Step
description: Measure average absolute change between successive readings, yielding zero for a series with fewer than two observations.

title: Tab Column
description: Advance a zero-based text column to the next tab stop for a positive tab width.

title: Widow Split
description: Choose the largest paragraph prefix that fits while leaving a minimum count on each side. Zero means defer the paragraph to the next page.

title: Utf16 Units
description: Count UTF-16 code units for an array of Unicode scalar values and reject malformed scalar values.

title: Rle Encoded Pairs
description: Count count-value runs required for a bounded run-length encoding, splitting long repeated runs at the configured maximum.

title: Sequence Edit Distance
description: Compute unit-cost Levenshtein distance between two token ID sequences using one dynamic programming row.

title: Bracket Depth
description: Check a stream encoded as plus one for open and minus one for close and return maximum balanced nesting. Reject premature closes and unfinished groups.

title: Test Streak
description: Find the longest consecutive run of failures in test results encoded as zero for pass and one for failure.

title: Test Flips
description: Count observed pass-to-fail or fail-to-pass transitions across reruns of one test. Reject nonbinary results.

title: Assert Close Count
description: Count coordinate deviations exceeding an absolute plus relative reference tolerance. Reject unequal vectors or negative tolerances.

title: Focus Next Enabled
description: Return the next enabled control index in a circular tab order. Return minus one when every control is disabled or the starting index is invalid.
